path.description: Source directory or file path to process. If omitted, current directory is processed.

res.description: Output resolution in HRESxVRES or percentage.

rotate.description: Rotate clockwise by specified angle in degrees. Negative inputs rotate anti-clockwise. 0 is not allowed.

adaptive.description: Adapt to specified resolution considering the orientation of the image.

convert.description: Convert PNG images to JPEG to save on space.

eraseexif.description: Erase EXIF metadata of JPEG images.

force.description: Force to the exact specified resolution.

includeimgp.description: Process _IMGP files. Risky due to potential race conditions.

keep.description: Do not process if image hres or vres matches specified hres or vres, or --res is 100.

enlarge.description: Enlarge smaller images. By default smaller images are not scaled if specified resolution is greater.

nearest.description: Use nearest neighbour interpolation for PNG images instead of default antialias.

optimize.description: Optimize output images using PIL library optimization algorithm.

progressive.description: Save all output JPEG images as progressive, even if the source is not.

quality.description: Save the image with a specified quality factor N (scale 1-95, default 75). JPEG only.

mute.description: Do not show any operational output.

minres.description: Minimum resolution in HxV or percentage of --res to resize.

recurse.description: Recursively process sub-directories. Symbolic links are ignored.

size.description: Minimum size in bytes required to process an image. Default 1024 bytes.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the source images. By default an output image is saved with _IMGP appended.
